definitions.explanation: A customer a business already has, as opposed to one it is trying to win. Standard marketing and sales vocabulary, usually contrasted with {新規|しんき}{客|きゃく} (new customers).

examples.japanese: {既存客|きぞんきゃく}を{大切|たいせつ}にしたい。
examples.english: We want to take good care of our existing customers.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{割引|わりびき}は{既存客|きぞんきゃく}のみが{対象|たいしょう}だ。
examples.english: This discount applies only to existing customers.

examples.japanese: {新規|しんき}{開拓|かいたく}よりも{既存客|きぞんきゃく}の{維持|いじ}のほうが{費用|ひよう}が{少|すく}なくて{済|す}む。
examples.english: Retaining existing customers costs less than developing new ones.

notes:
Formed from {既存|きぞん} (existing, already in place) plus {客|きゃく} (customer). The fuller {既存|きぞん}{顧客|こきゃく} is also common and sounds slightly more formal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既存客|きぞんきゃく}を{維持|いじ}する: to retain existing customers
- {既存客|きぞんきゃく}{向|む}けサービス: services aimed at existing customers
- {既存客|きぞんきゃく}からの{紹介|しょうかい}: a referral from an existing customer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新規|しんき}{客|きゃく}: new customer — the standard contrast
- {常連|じょうれん}: regular customer — everyday word implying repeated, familiar visits rather than a database category
